Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

translations.web: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
translations.bsb: “If Your Presence does not go with us,” Moses replied, “do not lead us up from here.
translations.kjv: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up
translations.asv: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
